newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Motor to post record profit in 97/98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Motor to post record profit in 97/98 - paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp is expected to post a record parent current profit of around 750 billion yen in the 1997/98 fiscal year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Monday.
This would be a rise of about 20 percent from the company's estimated profit for the 1996/97 financial year, which is due to be announced later this month.
The weaker yen is expected to boost profits by around 120 billion yen in the current business year, the paper said.
The previous record was in the year to June 1990, in which Toyota posted a parent current profit of 733.8 billion yen.
Sales in 1997/98 are expected to reach 9.3 trillion yen.
Exports in 1997/98 will slightly exceed the previous year's level, the paper said.
A spokesman for the company declined to comment on the Nikkei report, and said the firm would announce its earnings forecast for 1997/98 on May 21.
